SELECT a.user_id, a.user_name, b.nickname, b.stored_name as profileImageName, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM friend_tbl f WHERE (f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.friend_user_id = a.user_id) or (f.user_id = a.user_id AND f.friend_user_id = #{userId}) ) AS friend FROM user_tbl a JOIN profile_tbl b ON a.user_id = b.user_id WHERE (b.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or (a.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%' , #{keyword} , '%'))
LIMIT 20
